summary.text: Indigo Oliver is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Toby Thompson in an open-seat race.
Oliver is a licensed mental health therapist who says she is running on health care costs, public schools and cost-of-living relief.

paragraphs.text: Indigo Oliver earned a graduate degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2017.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a licensed mental health therapist and small business owner who opened a private practice in 2021 and specializes in trauma therapy.

She listed her campaign priorities as lowering health care costs and increasing access to mental health care, strengthening public schools and raising teacher pay, and cost-of-living and tax relief for working and middle-class families.
